domain.description: Registered domain name of the publisher (e.g. worldnews.com).

category.description: Primary content vertical of the domain. Empty string triggers unclassified scoring.

monthly_visits.description: Estimated total unique monthly visits to the domain.

geo_distribution.description: Fractional share of monthly traffic per geography. Values must sum to ~1.0.

US.description: Share of traffic from the United States.

UK.description: Share of traffic from the United Kingdom.

other.description: Aggregate share from all remaining geographies.

bounce_rate.description: Single-page session rate as a decimal fraction (e.g. 0.42 = 42%).
